attributes.name: Blessing of Xoveron
attributes.powers:
When you encounter this card, if you are at a location that has the Abyssal trait, you automatically acquire this card; otherwise, you may bury a card to acquire.

Discard this card to add 2 dice to a check by a character at a location that has the Abyssal trait.

Discard this card to explore your location.

After you play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Corrupted trait, discard a card.
